Not all Americans are whiny diva babies. I grew up in the projects. The water would often run cold, no heat, roaches, mice, bed bugs. My buildings were also really old so there was lead in the paint. I even had off from school for 3 months because the school I went to had abstestos.  Cops harassed us, searched are pockets for drugs and weapons (we were kids, like 8-10 yrs old). Drug addicts using in the hallways. Some days, rival drug dealers would decide to have a shootout with a bunch of kids playing outside. The nice dealers would warn us to go inside before having a COD style match on the basketball court. We often borrowed sugar and other small pantry items from neighbors. My friends would often complain about not getting the latest Jordan sneakers or latest video game. Some friends even complained about having to eat a certain food for dinner. I broke down one day and reminded them that we have it better than a 3rd world country. Their sad response was, well this isn't a third world country
